visual_goal: Show three money flows in one group: agency money runs from the hotel to the marketplace, while merchant and facilitated money runs through Corvane Payments to the supply side.
prompt: A left-to-right landscape diagram in two horizontal bands separated by a thin soft divider. At the far left, one generic guest figure spanning both bands. Top band: one green arrow from the guest to a small hotel building labeled 'Hotel'; the arrow carries the single label 'pays at desk'. Then one orange arrow from the hotel to a plain office building labeled 'Roomstead'; this arrow carries the single label 'commission'. Bottom band: one green arrow from the guest to a central teal building labeled 'Corvane Payments', carrying the single label 'pays at booking'. From 'Corvane Payments' two blue arrows go right: one to a second small hotel labeled 'Merchant hotel', carrying the single label 'virtual card', and one to a small house labeled 'Host', carrying the single label 'payout'. Each arrow label appears exactly once, written beside its arrow, never repeated or doubled.
alt: Agency money flowing from guest to hotel and commission to Roomstead, while merchant and facilitated money flows from guest through Corvane Payments to a hotel by virtual card and to a host by payout.

visual_goal: Show one resolver combining three inputs into an arrangement that the reservation freezes and all money systems consume.
prompt: A top-to-bottom hub diagram. At the top, three small input cards side by side: a contract document labeled 'Partner contract', a globe card labeled 'Market rules', and a shopper card labeled 'Guest choice'. Three arrows converge downward from them into one central gear labeled 'Resolver'. One arrow down from the gear to a ticket labeled 'Offer', then one arrow down to a sealed, padlocked folder labeled 'Reservation'. From the padlocked folder, five arrows fan out downward to a row of five small generic boxes labeled 'Ledger', 'Card issuing', 'Invoicing', 'Payouts' and 'Delivery'. All five arrows start at the padlocked folder, none from the gear.
alt: Partner contract, market rules and guest choice feeding one resolver, which produces an offer frozen in the reservation, which fans out to ledger, card issuing, invoicing, payouts and delivery.

visual_goal: Show a guest switching to Pay now creating arrangement version 2, with one event reaching the ledger, card issuing and invoicing at once.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration. At the left, a generic guest figure taps a phone, with one arrow to a box labeled 'Checkout' labeled 'Pay now'. One arrow from 'Checkout' to a gear labeled 'Resolver', and one arrow back from the gear to Checkout carrying a small card labeled 'v2'. One arrow from Checkout to a folder labeled 'Reservation'. From the Reservation folder, one broadcast signal splits into three arrows, each labeled 'v1 to v2', going to three lanes on the right: a ledger book labeled 'Ledger', a small glowing digital voucher tile labeled 'Issuing', and an invoice sheet labeled 'Invoicing' with a small removal mark. The three right-side items line up vertically so they visibly receive the same event.
alt: A guest switches to Pay now; checkout gets arrangement version 2 from the resolver, the reservation applies it and sends the same v1-to-v2 event to ledger, issuing and invoicing.
